contract: Five opens of one immutable generated closed H264 interval. Baseline remuxes on every open; candidate remuxes once, retains bounded prepared bytes and verifies source/recipe/profile identity on each acquisition. Every opened output must decode exactly to original source pictures.
sampling: Nine alternating paired jobs; cold empty cache each candidate job. Complete source read/hash, first preparation, every owned output copy and every decode included. Host FFmpeg process startup included; same file/OS caches shared.
metric: Complete five-open wall time; retained prepared bytes and max entry budget reported separately
threshold: All exact outputs and wrong identity/corrupt-entry controls pass; paired savings bootstrap95% lower bound exceeds10% to merit pursuit for this repeated-open profile. No single-open benefit or browser integration speed claim.
